program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = time; const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const isAtOrPastApex = t >= apexTime; const dropTime = isAtOrPastApex ? t - apexTime : 0; const dropVelocity = isAtOrPastApex ? -gravity * dropTime : 0; const dropAcceleration = isAtOrPastApex ? -gravity : 0; const dropHeight = isAtOrPastApex ? apexHeight - (gravity * dropTime * dropTime) / 2 : apexHeight; const panelW = 280; const panelH = 340; const y0 = 360; const hScale = 110; const tossX = 140; const dropX = 460; const toScreenY = (h) => y0 - h * hScale; const tossBallY = toScreenY(tossedHeight); const dropBallY = toScreenY(dropHeight); let tossState = "At launch"; if (t > 0.05 && t < apexTime - 0.05) tossState = "Rising"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) <= 0.05) tossState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime + 0.05 && tossedHeight > 0.05) tossState = "Falling"; else if (tostedHeight <= 0.05 && t > 0.1) tossState = "At launch height"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (isAtOrPastApex && dropTime < 0.05) dropState = "Just released"; else if (dropTime >= 0.05 && dropHeight > 0.05) dropState = "Falling together"; else if (dropHeight <= 0.05 && dropTime > 0.1) dropState = "At launch height"; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 30, y: 30, w: panelW, h: panelH, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 330, y: 30, w: panelW, h: panelH, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.toss", { x: tossX, y: y0, length: 2.2 * hScale, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.drop", { x: dropX, y: y0, length: 2.2 * hScale, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.groundMark("ground.toss", tossX, y0, 60, "Launch")); objects.push(sdk.groundMark("ground.drop", dropX, y0, 60, "Apex")); if (!isAtOrPastApex) { objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate.drop", dropX, toScreenY(apexHeight), { open: false, label: "Gate" })); } else { objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate.drop", dropX, toScreenY(apexHeight), { open: true, label: "Gate" })); } objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, tossBallY, 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, dropBallY, 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 22, y: tossBallY }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 22, y: tossBallY }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 6, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 22, y: dropBallY }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 22, y: dropBallY }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 6, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 45, tossBallY - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 1) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 45, dropBallY - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 1) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.drop" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, tossedVelocity: tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration: tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight: tossedHeight, dropVelocity: dropVelocity, dropAcceleration: dropAcceleration, dropHeight: dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top of a vertical toss, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity continues to accelerate the ball at -g. A second ball released at that moment falls alongside it.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball on the left and a dropped ball on the right. Velocity and acceleration vectors accompany each ball alongside live numerical readouts.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration. Press Play again to continue, or drag the timeline.
